create_instance.description: Create a virtual machine and start it, from an operating system image, an instance template or a machine image.

parameters.description: The zone, such as us-central1-a. Pick one, or give it from an earlier step.

output.deleted_by: Who deleted it (a person's email or a service account)
output.name: The deleted instance's name
output.operation: The name of the delete operation, for 'Get operation'

parameters.description: Only this zone, such as us-central1-a. Leave blank for every zone.

google_compute_engine_instance_status_ch.description: Runs when an instance starts running, is stopped or is suspended, including a new instance once it is running. Instances as they are when the workflow is turned on don't start it.

output.external_ip: Its external IP address; empty if it has none
output.instance: Everything about the instance, as 'Get instance' returns it
output.machine_type: Its machine type, such as e2-medium
output.name: The instance's name

parameters.name: zone
